excerpt: Journalism Concentration Journalism concentrators will gain: - knowledge of the workings and history of commercial and non-profit media - deep knowledge of journalistic norms and ethical standards - a complete palette of multimedia reporting skills, including social media journalism, data journalism and data visualization Students choose two courses for six credits. Recently offered courses include: - PMMA 6101 - Audio Narrative (reporting and production) - PMMA 6103 - Data Journalism and Interactive Graphics - PMMA 6108 - Advanced Interviews and Profiles - PMMA 6110 - Digital Storytelling Additional courses in the curriculum include: - PMMA 6102 - Video Narrative (reporting and production) - PMMA 6104 - Alternative and Advocacy Journalism - PMMA 6105 - Cross-Platform Journalism - PMMA 6106 - Online Journalism - PMMA 6107 - Opinion Writing
